subject.title: fix(codex): surface native subagent task updates

question: Should native Codex subagent task visibility inherit from any explicit embedded delivery route, including cron, or only from parent runs that are explicitly human-visible?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the PR changes scheduled-run delivery semantics in a way tests and source show can surface child task updates from otherwise silent cron flows.

options.title: Gate On Parent Visibility
options.body: Propagate requesterOrigin to Codex native mirrors only when the parent flow is intended to be human-visible, and keep cron/system-silent routes quiet.

options.title: Allow Cron Child Updates
options.body: Accept that explicit cron delivery routes receive Codex child task updates, but require the PR to document and prove that behavior with live channel evidence.

options.title: Defer The PR
options.body: Keep #87666 open and replace or pause this branch until the visibility policy and merge conflicts are resolved.

recommendation.title: Gate On Parent Visibility
recommendation.body: Propagate requesterOrigin to Codex native mirrors only when the parent flow is intended to be human-visible, and keep cron/system-silent routes quiet.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the adjacent ordinary subagent visibility change and is the best available owner for the parent-visibility policy choice.
